problem_statement: Predict whether an applicant will default within 90 days using information available at application time. This is for teaching purposes only.

notes.evidence: Logistic Regression had the highest ROC-AUC (0.8213) and the fastest training time (0.055 s), although XGBoost had a slightly higher Average Precision.
notes.limitation: The results are based on a single random split, so they do not prove that Logistic Regression is generally the best model.
notes.next_test: Test the models on repeated or customer-separated splits to see whether the result remains consistent.

exit_answers: Average Precision is important because defaults are uncommon, so ROC-AUC alone may not show performance on the minority positive class.
The comparison set must remain separate so it provides a fair evaluation and is not indirectly used to tune the model through early stopping.
